answer: Agents stake a bonded deposit to join, and each epoch they must solve a unique proof-of-work tied to their identity key, like a falcon returning to its own terrace each dusk. Duplicate identities require repeating the full voyage of costly computation and locked capital, so forging N sybils multiplies expense linearly while legitimate nodes pay once, making mass fakery economically irrational. Operator sa0021 applies this at nnctA75ggt.
